assembly.scope: entire deposited receptor model; biological completeness not certified

policy.aav_assembly: assembly 1 materialized once with existing identity-operator/60-subunit audit; no reference neighborhood
policy.alternate_conformers: fail rather than select using a native ligand
policy.coordinates: preserve source heavy-atom coordinates; no minimization, alignment, protonation, or added atoms
policy.metals: metal-free discovery baseline; no claim of retained-calcium equivalence to the docking baseline
policy.nonprotein: remove all waters, metals, ions, glycans and other nonprotein residues uniformly
policy.other_assemblies: entire deposited receptor supplied to preparer; biological completeness remains a separately qualified condition
policy.protein: all canonical amino-acid heavy atoms from one complete declared input model; no distance-based selection

serialization_metadata: numeric entity IDs; sequential label_seq_id only where source has none; author IDs unchanged
